headline: SIGN: 2 low-severity issues require internal review
nextAction: Karandeep will review the insurance limit and liquidated damages clause changes.

findings.title: Professional liability insurance limit requires confirmation
findings.impact: AtliQ may not meet contract requirements upon signing if its existing policy coverage falls short of $1,000,000.

citations.quote: Provider shall maintain professional liability and cyber liability insurance of $1,000,000 each

findings.standard: Check every required insurance type and limit against what AtliQ actually holds before signing (known: cyber $1M; everything else unrecorded).
findings.counterPosition: Verify internal policy limits for professional liability prior to signing, or adjust the contractual requirement to reflect existing coverage.

findings.title: LD clause lacks express sole remedy statement
findings.impact: Greystone could attempt to seek additional damages for delay beyond the agreed liquidated damages cap.

citations.quote: Liquidated damages of 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week of Provider-caused delay, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; not applicable to delays caused by Greystone or force majeure

findings.standard: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week of delay attributable to AtliQ, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; no LDs for client-caused delay; LDs are the sole remedy for delay.
findings.counterPosition: Add language clarifying that liquidated damages are the sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

hits.label: untagged

hits.heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
hits.label: standard
hits.text:
4.1 The total fees for the Services are **USD 48,000** (United States Dollars Forty-Eight Thousand only), payable on completion of Milestones as set out in Annexure A.

4.2 The Service Provider shall raise an invoice upon completion of each Milestone. The Company shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt of the invoice.

similar.quote: 5.1 Mutual. Each party protects the other's Confidential Information with reasonable care; obligations survive three (3) years, and indefinitely for trade secrets and claimant personal information.

hits.heading: CONFIDENTIALITY
hits.label: untagged
hits.text:
7.1 Each Party shall hold the other Party's Confidential Information in confidence, use it only to perform or receive the Services, and disclose it only to its personnel and advisors with a need to know who are bound by obligations at least as protective.

7.2 The obligations in Section 7.1 do not apply to information that is or becomes publicly available without breach, was known to the recipient prior to disclosure, is independently developed, or is rightfully received from a third party.

7.3 These obligations survive for three (3) years following termination, and indefinitely for trade secrets.
hits.differs: Worse for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: confidentiality survives indefinitely for claimant personal information, not just trade secrets.

hits.label: standard

hits.heading: INDEMNITY
hits.label: standard
hits.labelNote: Origin of the mutual-indemnity position: no indemnity for the indemnified party's own negligence
hits.text:
10.1 Each Party (the "**Indemnifying Party**") shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the other Party and its directors, officers and employees (the "**Indemnified Party**") from and against all Losses arising out of any third-party claim to the extent caused by: (a) the Indemnifying Party's breach of Clause 7 (Confidentiality) or Clause 12 (Data Protection); (b) the gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud of the Indemnifying Party or its personnel; or (c) in the case of AtliQ, any claim that the Deliverables infringe a third party's intellectual property rights, and in the case of PayTrack, any claim that Client Data or materials supplied by PayTrack infringe a third party's rights.

10.2 Neither Party shall be required to indemnify the other to the extent any Losses are caused by the negligence, breach or wilful misconduct of the Indemnified Party.

10.3 The Indemnified Party shall give prompt written notice of any claim, permit the Indemnifying Party to control the defence and settlement, and provide reasonable cooperation at the Indemnifying Party's cost.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: intellectual property infringement indemnification is mutual rather than required only from AtliQ.

similar.quote: 10.1 Liquidated damages of 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week of Provider-caused delay, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; not applicable to delays caused by Greystone or force majeure.

hits.heading: DELAY AND LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
hits.label: standard
hits.labelNote: Origin of the LD playbook: 0.5% of milestone/week, 5% cap, client delays excluded (Mar 2025)
hits.text:
7.1 If the Service Provider fails to complete a Milestone by the agreed date for reasons solely attributable to the Service Provider, the Service Provider shall pay liquidated damages at the rate of 0.5% (half percent) of the Milestone Fee of the delayed Milestone for each complete week of delay.

7.2 The aggregate liquidated damages in respect of any Milestone shall not exceed 5% (five percent) of the Milestone Fee of that Milestone.

7.3 No liquidated damages shall be payable where the delay is caused by the Client, including delayed access to data or systems, delayed review of Deliverables, or changes in scope, or by a Force Majeure event.

7.4 The Parties agree that the liquidated damages are a genuine pre-estimate of loss and shall be the Client's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.
hits.differs: Same as Acme Retail Group: delay penalty of 0.5% per week is capped at 5% of the milestone fee, excluding client delays.

hits.heading: DELIVERY, ACCEPTANCE AND LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
hits.label: exception
hits.labelNote: One-off: "strategic exception for Al Noor only, not our new standard" (cap 10% of total fees)
hits.text:
10.1 The Supplier shall use all reasonable endeavours to achieve each Milestone by the date set out in the relevant SOW.

10.2 Each Deliverable shall be subject to acceptance testing by the Client within ten (10) Business Days of delivery against the acceptance criteria in the SOW. Deliverables not rejected in writing within that period shall be deemed accepted.

10.3 If the Supplier fails to achieve a Milestone by its due date for reasons attributable to the Supplier, the Supplier shall pay to the Client, as liquidated damages, one percent (1%) of the Fees payable for the affected Milestone for each complete week of delay, provided that the aggregate liquidated damages payable under this Agreement shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the total Fees payable under this Agreement.

10.4 The Parties agree that the liquidated damages in Clause 10.3 are a genuine pre-estimate of loss. No liquidated damages shall be payable for delay caused by the Client, its contractors, or a Force Majeure Event.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: delay penalty is 0.5% per week capped at 5% instead of 1%.

hits.heading: DELAY AND LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
hits.label: accident
hits.labelNote: Signed on a phone in 4 minutes: 1%/day uncapped LDs, no client-delay exclusion, group set-off, English law on a US entity. Cost $9k + $14.2k legal
hits.text:
9.1 If the Supplier fails to achieve any Key Date, the Supplier shall pay to the Customer liquidated damages in the amount of one per cent (1%) of the Contract Value for each day or part day by which the relevant Key Date is missed.

9.2 Liquidated damages under clause 9.1 shall be payable in addition to any other right or remedy available to the Customer under this Agreement or at law, and the Customer may deduct such liquidated damages from any sums due to the Supplier.

9.3 The Supplier acknowledges that the liquidated damages set out in this clause 9 are proportionate to the Customer's legitimate interest in the timely delivery of the Services.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: penalty is 0.5% per week capped at 5% of milestone fee, excluding client delays.

similar.quote: 11.1 Provider shall comply with the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act Safeguards Rule as applicable to service providers and with Greystone's security schedule; notify security incidents within seventy-two (72) hours.

hits.heading: DATA PROTECTION AND INFORMATION SECURITY
hits.label: untagged
hits.text:
13.1 The Supplier shall comply with all applicable data protection laws, including the Connecticut Data Privacy Act and the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, and the Brightwater Group Information Security Schedule.

13.2 The Supplier shall notify the Customer of any security incident affecting Customer Data within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of it.

13.3 The Supplier shall not process Customer Data outside the United States without the Customer's prior written consent.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: incident notification deadline is 72 hours instead of 24 hours.

hits.heading: DATA SECURITY
hits.label: untagged
hits.text:
13.1 Supplier shall comply with Crestline's Vendor Data Security Requirements, as updated from time to time, and all applicable U.S. federal and state privacy laws, including the Ohio Data Protection Act where applicable.

13.2 Supplier shall notify Crestline within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of any security incident affecting Crestline data.

13.3 Supplier shall not access Crestline production data from outside the United States without Crestline's prior written approval.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: does not require prior written approval for accessing data outside the United States.

hits.heading: DATA PROTECTION AND AUDIT
hits.label: untagged
hits.text:
13.1 The Service Provider shall comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the Information Technology Act, 2000 and applicable RBI directions in processing Company Data, and shall store Company Data only in India.

13.2 The Service Provider shall report any security incident to the Company within six (6) hours of detection.

13.3 The Company, its auditors and the Reserve Bank of India shall have the right to inspect and audit the Service Provider's records and facilities relating to the Services.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: incident notification deadline is 72 hours instead of 6 hours, without data residency restrictions.
